title: Serena Williams: Seven Matches, One Secret
description: She lifted a trophy while hiding life-changing news—five steps from a secret title to motherhood.

questions.question: In January 2017, Serena Williams won which Grand Slam while newly pregnant?
questions.explanation: She won the title in Melbourne without revealing she was expecting—one of the most talked-about victories in Open-era tennis.

questions.question: At that Australian Open, Serena beat her older sister in the final—who?
questions.explanation: Serena defeated Venus 6–4, 6–4 in the final—their 28th major final meeting, with the pregnancy still a secret to the public.

questions.question: After beating Venus in the Australian Open final, Serena was roughly how many weeks pregnant?
questions.explanation: She found out she was expecting about a week before the tournament—roughly eight weeks along when she hoisted the trophy over her sister in Melbourne.

questions.question: Roughly eight weeks along when she won in Melbourne, Serena revealed her pregnancy in April 2017—on which app did she post a mirror selfie?
questions.explanation: The mirror selfie on Snapchat—captioned with a baby emoji—announced the news to the world months after that secret Australian Open triumph.

questions.question: After announcing her pregnancy on Snapchat, Serena and Alexis Ohanian welcomed a daughter in September 2017—what is her first name?
questions.explanation: Alexis Olympia Ohanian Jr.—"Olympia"—closed the arc from secret champion to public motherhood.
